SECURITY AWARENESS

Better password habits

⟡

Go longer

Use a long random password or a passphrase made from randomly chosen, unrelated words.

⌘

Make each one unique

Use a different password for every account. A password manager can create and save them for you.

⊕

Turn on MFA

Multifactor authentication adds another check when someone tries to sign in with your password.

Guidance from NIST and CISA.
